resources.string: Normal logging by default; enable details temporarily when troubleshooting
Detailed diagnostics active · up to %1$d min remaining

Enable detailed logs for up to 10 minutes in currently running app processes? Normal logging resumes automatically, including while this page is closed. Restarted processes use normal logging. To diagnose a VPN, connect it first. Logs may contain server addresses and visited domains; inspect them before sharing. This does not reconnect the VPN.
Stop detailed diagnostics now and return to normal logging?
Logging, refresh frequency and subscription TLS no longer need tuning

Logs now roll within a 256 KiB limit, using normal detail unless you explicitly enable temporary diagnostics. Traffic refreshes every second while the main page is visible, and every 30 seconds for background statistics. Counters and final totals are still collected; your per-profile statistics choice is retained.

Subscription HTTPS requires TLS 1.2 or newer, including TLS 1.3 negotiation. Failures never trigger a TLS downgrade or disable certificate verification. Your explicit certificate-validation setting remains unchanged.

Previous values for log level, log capacity, refresh interval and subscription minimum TLS are preserved in local settings/backups but no longer control these policies. No nodes, subscriptions, DNS providers or routing rules were changed.
